title: Oyo Atuumiddwa Erinnya mu Nnyumba ya Nabbi
intro: Mu maka g’omubaka asembayo, mwalimu emmeeme emboozi ye ey’obuntu gye yafuuka essomo ery’obwakatonda eri abakkiriza bonna. Obulamu bw’omuntu ono bwali bukwatagana nnyo n’ekiragiro ekikyusa ekyaddamu okukola empisa z’embeera z’abantu emirembe gyonna, ekyalaga enkyukakyuka ey’amaanyi mu ngeri okukkiriza gye kwandinnyonnyoddemu amaka n’okubeera.
clues: Lumu erinnya lyange lyali likwatagana n’olunyiriri olw’ekitiibwa, naye oluvannyuma amazima agasingako awo ganditangaaze ku miguwa egy’amazima egy’okukkiriza.
Nze nali mufuna ekisa ekinene okuva eri Allah n’omubaka we, ekisa ekyalangirirwa mu lujjudde mu Kitabo.
Obulamu bwange obw’obufumbo bwafuuka ekigezo ekikulu ekyandikyusizza emirembe gyonna endowooza y’omukwano gw’abazadde.
Nze eyali omusango gwe ogw’obuntu gwe gwaviirako ekiragiro eky’obwakatonda ekyakkiriza Nabbi okuwasa omukazi nga mmaze okugenda.
Okuyita mu mboozi yange, enjawulo wakati w’amaka ag’obutonde n’agarondeddwa yategeezebwa bulungi eri emirembe gyonna.
Nze nzekka mu bannange erinnya lyange erirabikira mu bulambulukufu mu kubikkulirwa okusembayo, si nga nnabbi, wabula ng’omuweereza eyagezesebwa era n’aweebwa ekitiibwa.

arabic: وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًۭا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌۭ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًۭا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًۭا
verse: And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished. (33:37)
